description:
Survey external implementations of large-batch BCH encoding and generator-matrix materialization, select the strongest available baselines reproducibly, and fix the exact workload-selection contract the encoding and benchmark tasks consume.

## Background

The SOTA target-matrix conventions supply the pinning and receipt format; its coverage is linear-algebra-centric and records GF(2^m) gaps, so BCH-encoder baselines must be established. The survey fixes, before any optimization work: the exact benchmark codes, batch sizes, matrix dimensions, cache state, worker counts, the encoding algorithm families to register, and the baseline library versions and build flags — completing the plan's evidence-protocol skeleton into the concrete workload-selection contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A survey document pins candidate libraries with versions and build configuration, measures the two workloads under a stated protocol, and selects the strongest baseline per workload with committed receipts.
- [hard] REQ-02: The workload-selection contract is fixed: exact codes, batch sizes, matrix dimensions, cache state, worker counts, and algorithm families, predeclared before optimization tasks consume them.
title: Reproducible external-baseline survey and workload selection
